title: Pikachu Confused
blurb: Audio companion to the most-used reaction image of the last decade — the open-mouthed Pikachu screencap pulled from a 1997 episode and repurposed in 2018 to mean something very specific. Not general surprise, but shock at an entirely predictable outcome: the consequences you were explicitly warned about, arriving exactly on schedule, to a face that cannot believe it. Play it when somebody acts astonished by the direct results of their own decisions. It is the most passive-aggressive expression of sympathy available, which is precisely why it has never gone out of use.
origin: The confused vocalisation behind the Surprised Pikachu meme.
